prompt:
Use the reference image ONLY for the character's design; redraw it in the style described. Single game hero sprite: a tall menacing horned fire demon with a small dark helmet head, two huge long curved dark horns, huge spiked shoulder pauldrons, a narrow dark torso with a ragged hanging cloth, dark armoured greaves, and two long arms made of flat layered orange and yellow flame ending in big flame hands; dark charcoal-grey armour, orange main flame colour, bright yellow accent; hands empty, no weapon. The same character, same SIDE VIEW (facing RIGHT, body turned about 30 degrees toward the viewer, far arm partly hidden), same proportions, colours and gear as the reference, but in this pose: KNEELING low on one knee on the ground, head bowed, both flame arms drooping down to the ground with the flames small and low, motionless; no effects around the body.
SIMPLE: the face is only a small ember slit; flame hands are simple big flame shapes. No buckles, no pouches, no straps, no rope, no stitches, no fabric texture. At most three colour families (charcoal grey, orange, yellow). Same horns, spikes and flame arms as the reference, nothing added, no weapon. The whole body, both horns' tips and all flames stay fully inside the frame with margin on every side. Full body, centered, filling about 70% of the frame.

STYLE: Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette. Flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture. Volume from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. The fire is stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes with an outline that follows the flame tongues, never soft blur or glow. No aura, no rim light, not pixel art. Light from the top-left.

BACKGROUND: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject.

OUTPUT: one image, 1024x1024, one character only.
